trajectory.title: Trajectory envelope and headroom
trajectory.description: Align the mean and 90th percentile in time. Their margins show how close each profile comes to the upper limit.

ridges.title: Conditional ridgeline distributions
ridges.description: Density peaks show where observations cluster. Medians and quartiles show how the distributions shift across conditions.

chord.title: Pairwise connections and weight matrix
chord.description: Each ribbon width comes from the matrix at right. Outlined cells identify the pairs with maximal weight.
chord.tags: Relation network · Weight matrix · Maximum pairs

cluster.title: Clustered correlation matrix
cluster.description: The tree and matrix use the same variable order. Read the blocks for within-group correlation and the off-diagonal blocks for its sign between groups.

spatial.title: Spatial field and network samples
spatial.description: Find each network node on the map. The ranking at right compares field intensity at the same node locations.
spatial.tags: Spatial field · Node samples · Network links

feasibility.title: Feasible-state projection and binding constraints
feasibility.description: Arrows connect each original state to the nearest feasible point. The side panel records the distance and the active constraints.
feasibility.tags: Feasible domain · Euclidean projection · Active constraints

sankey.title: Multi-stage allocation and flow balance
sankey.description: Follow the ribbon widths through three stages. Node values let you check flow conservation at each stage.

raincloud.title: Raincloud distributions and intervals
raincloud.description: Read the observations and their density on each row. The box spans the middle half of the sample and the whiskers mark the 10th and 90th percentiles.

polar.title: Circular profiles and between-condition range
polar.description: The four rings share the hour scale. Their colors show condition-specific response and the range trace at right identifies the hours of greatest spread.

parallel.title: Multi-metric parallel coordinates
parallel.description: Each line represents one case. Crossings show where cases change rank between neighboring metrics.

calibration.title: Calibration and discrimination diagnostics
calibration.description: Use the bin counts to interpret the width of the calibration intervals. The companion distributions show where the classes overlap in predicted probability.
calibration.tags: Calibration intervals · Bin counts · Probability distributions

spectrum.title: Signal, time-frequency structure and spectral power
spectrum.description: The spectrogram locates frequency components in time. The profile at right sums power over windows to compare total power at each frequency.

forest.title: Paired differences and effect intervals
forest.description: The left panel shows the paired differences in each condition. On the right, a zero line shows which corresponding mean intervals cross zero.

gantt.title: Resource assignment and capacity headroom
gantt.description: Read vehicle assignments and aggregate power on the same time axis. A diamond marks the hour with the least headroom.
